data.question: Which named people bridge the Trump Foundation, 5p2, industry, government, defense-adjacent institutions and Benjamin Netanyahu?
data.method: Public-source entity resolution followed by set-membership intersection ranking. A person receives one membership for each independently sourced cluster; pairwise intersection count is n(n-1)/2 and is used only to prioritize research.
data.framework: Separate direct documented relationships, institutional career bridges, event co-participation and disputed influence claims.
data.scope: Trump Foundation family and governance; 5p2; Rashi; Intel Israel; Education Ministry; RAMA; Yad Hanadiv; Knesset defense oversight; Haifa Chemicals; Netanyahu.
findings: Jules Trump occupies four sourced sets:foundation family, industrial ownership, direct Netanyahu acquaintance and state regulatory intervention. This produces six pairwise intersections and makes him the highest-priority bridge.
Netanyahu's office acknowledged acquaintance with Jules Trump but denied that it influenced the ammonia-tank decision and said the two had not discussed the tank.
Jules Trump later wrote Netanyahu directly about the Haifa Chemicals shutdown and government-promised alternatives.
Eli Hurvitz bridges Trump Foundation management, Rothschild-family philanthropy through Yad Hanadiv, and prior staff work for the chair of the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee.
Michal Cohen bridges Rashi Foundation leadership and prior senior control of the Education Ministry; this is a revolving-door institutional bridge, not proof she founded 5p2.
Bella Abrahams provides a named Intel-to-5p2 operational bridge and describes engineer mobilization across Intel and 25 other companies.
Michal Beller bridges Trump Foundation governance or advice, the founding leadership of RAMA, and 5p2's measurement collaboration with RAMA.
Netanyahu and Gideon Sa'ar publicly presented a Trump Foundation-branded teaching award, establishing a direct event link between the foundation and senior government leadership.
conclusions: The graph is not merely an education network:it intersects industrial ownership, regulatory decisions, prime-ministerial contact, philanthropic governance, education administration, national measurement and defense-committee career history.
The Jules Trump–Netanyahu–Haifa Chemicals path is the strongest direct person-to-government cross-connection found in this pass.
No reviewed source proves improper intervention, quid pro quo, unified command of 5p2, or military control of education policy.
recommendations: Acquire the April 2017 PMO meeting record, government court filing and ministerial correspondence on the ammonia-tank delay.
Retrieve Israeli and U.S. corporate filings for Trump Group, Trans-Resource Inc. and Haifa Chemicals.
Recover the complete 5p2 steering committee and twelve interview subjects underlying Sheatufim's case study.
Identify the Knesset Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee chair whom Eli Hurvitz assisted and the dates of service.
Retrieve foundation board minutes and award-event records documenting government participation.
counterarguments: A prime minister may intervene in industrial regulation because of jobs and national supply without favoritism.
Career movement between government and philanthropy does not establish capture.
Participation in a coalition or award ceremony does not establish control.
limitations: The PMO meeting record and government court filing were not retrieved in this pass.
The complete 5p2 roster and interview transcripts are not publicly resolved.
Corporate ownership chronology requires registry records.
unresolved: Exact chronology and substance of Netanyahu's personal acquaintance with Jules Trump.
Whether any private communications preceded the April 2017 PMO meeting.
Named 5p2 steering committee members, government sponsors and defense/intelligence participants.
The identity of the Knesset committee chair assisted by Eli Hurvitz.
